verdict.rationale: Every SKILL.md must include a `name` and `description`, and the skill creator explicitly asks what the skill does and when it should trigger. Developers can inspect installed skills with `/skills` in the CLI or IDE extension, or in the Skills sidebar of the desktop app. Missing for 10: no explicit requirement that the description state activation conditions, no documentation of how descriptions drive automatic triggering, and no independent hands-on confirmation that activation is predictable from the docs.
